turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My bathroom sink smells awful. Like old eggs.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's usually gunk built up in the drain. Pull out the plug or stopper if you can, there's often hair wrapped around it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm starting a monthly film night at work and I need a theme for the year.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A few choices coming. No comments till the end, please.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could do heist films, one every month, which most people seem to love.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or go decade by decade, starting in the nineteen thirties and ending with something recent.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another thought is films that are all set in the same city, to compare how it changes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or the so bad it's good night, where we pick famously terrible films and laugh at them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done describing. Be my tiebreaker.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Heist films are crowd pleasers but might feel samey by month eight. Decade by decade gives you natural variety and a sense of progress. The same city idea is clever but could be hard to fill. The bad films night is fantastic fun for coworkers.
